title: Found the Zombie level apparently
content: The other night, I had a Mallworld dream. This time, it started in I think the edge of the Aquarium/ Fun museum area. I say the edge of it because when I became somewhat lucid, I was in a really vibrant area that felt like some sort of museum of music or an interactive art installation that was pond themed. Think giant lillypads and mushrooms. What's really wierd is after I became lucid the scene changed into what I can only describe as a Halloween themed college party in a large auditorium under blacklights, stuffed full of both scary and outright tacky decorations and statues. There were the usual glass double mall doors, and it was nighttime outside in the parking lot. Even wierder, when I made it to the exit doors of the building, instead of going outside, I turned back and walked around. I was eyed and chased first by some zombies. I was then accosted by a Banshee with a black scarf wound around her face, huge glowing eyes, and 8 ink black arms flailing around, and she was shrieking. Why did I dream about first positive things and then a sudden shift into dark, nasty junk that I can't stand and stay far away from irl?? Why did me becoming lucid trigger such a dramatic change?
